notes: three taḥwīl branches: the first two end at «أبي» and «حفص», the last one at «أبي» again; the text writes «عن الحسن بن عبيد الله ...» once, after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail
the text does not say that «أبي» and «حفص» are the same man: the surfaces are kept apart
«يرفعه» after أبي موسى is the report's attribution to the Prophet, not a gap, so the Prophet ends the chain
